taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: PDF active-content handling across generation, preview and recipient context
controls.source_trace: Trace lower-trust document content into an actual supported viewer capability such as navigation or embedded action; separate inert bytes from executed behavior.
controls.implementation_branch: Separate generator trust, server preview conversion and recipient viewer capabilities. JavaScript, embedded files and external actions may be ignored, blocked or require user interaction in the deployed viewer. An active-content object in PDF syntax is not proof it executes; use a harmless local marker and record the exact viewer/version and necessary interaction.
controls.operational_method: Select the actual PDF object/action trigger and product rule: for example document-open action, link action, embedded attachment or script action are different consumers. Retain the original and transformed object inventory, preview renderer and final downloaded viewer/version. Compare a harmless allowed document with a prohibited inert action marker through the real transformation. An object remaining in syntax is not proof it runs in a viewer that ignores or prompts for it.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local synthetic PDF and an owned harmless destination/marker in a constrained viewer fixture; compare intended passive content and the prohibited active behavior.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An action dictionary or script string in a PDF is not proof a recipient viewer executes it; viewer protections may reject it.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Remove or constrain prohibited active features in the actual publication/preview path, verifying legitimate rendering and rejected behavior.
